high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the Times Entertainment section of the Times of India website. The headline reads, "The oud 'boom' in the perfume industry recently." The article discusses the recent popularity of oud in perfumery, highlighting its unique scent profile that has captivated perfumers and fragrance enthusiasts. It mentions how luxury brands have incorporated oud into their products to offer depth, warmth, and opulence, contributing to the proliferation of oud-based scents.
